module purpose: This block matches a specific bit pattern in ctrl_i to form a command-valid decision, evaluates a predicate from rs2_i and ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1), and on rising clk_i conditionally writes either rs1_i or zero to res_o. It also reports the decode decision on valid_o.

predicate decision from the zero-test of rs2_i and ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1)
clocked conditional result word: res_o takes rs1_i when valid_cmd and condition are 1, otherwise all zeroes
decoded command-valid decision copied to valid_o
res_o forced to all zeroes while rstn_i is 0
